nodes.label: lexer.js (text to tokens, NL token, normalized words)
nodes.norm_label: lexer.js (text to tokens, nl token, normalized words)
nodes.rationale: One command per line in VisuAlg Portugol, so newline is its own token; words normalized (uppercase, no accents, synonyms) so entao/ENTAO match.

nodes.label: Electron main process (native menus, Windows-1252 files, prefs, recents)
nodes.norm_label: electron main process (native menus, windows-1252 files, prefs, recents)

nodes.label: maquina.js (generator-based AST executor)
nodes.rationale: JS generators (function*) yield before each line, freezing even mid-recursion, enabling step, breakpoints, leia and pause.

nodes.label: parser.js (recursive descent to AST)
nodes.rationale: Raises errors with exact VisuAlg text and line; operator precedence follows VisuAlg.

nodes.label: preload IPC bridge (renderer has no Node access)
nodes.norm_label: preload ipc bridge (renderer has no node access)

nodes.label: renderer main.js (toolbar, menu commands, open/save, crash recovery)
nodes.norm_label: renderer main.js (toolbar, menu commands, open/save, crash recovery)

nodes.label: Sessao (index.js) execution controller
nodes.rationale: Runs in slices of 20,000 lines, yielding to the browser between slices so the UI never freezes and Ctrl+F2 can always stop.

nodes.label: AppArmor profile in .deb (Chromium sandbox on Ubuntu 23.10+)
nodes.norm_label: apparmor profile in .deb (chromium sandbox on ubuntu 23.10+)
nodes.rationale: AppImage cannot install the profile, so .deb is recommended to keep the sandbox enabled.

nodes.label: Optional AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, DeepSeek, Gemini, Ollama) with hint mode
nodes.norm_label: optional ai assistant (claude, chatgpt/codex, deepseek, gemini, ollama) with hint mode
nodes.rationale: 100% offline by default; nothing sent to the internet unless the assistant is enabled (Ollama stays local).

nodes.label: MisterALG (Portugol IDE, VisuAlg-inspired)
nodes.rationale: VisuAlg runs only on Windows; MisterALG exists so Mac and Linux students can study with the same language, menus, keys and error messages.

nodes.label: 6 color themes (Classico default, Escuro, Meia-noite, Dracula, Terminal, Sepia)

nodes.label: .alg files in Windows-1252
nodes.rationale: Same encoding as VisuAlg so files open and save interchangeably.
